meta.tagline: Community sightings of the striped hat – a fan project
meta.description: HatSpotted is a non-commercial fan community where people share photos of striped-hat sightings and pin them on a world map.

footer.disclaimer: HatSpotted is an independent, non-commercial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Dr. Seuss Enterprises, L.P. or any other rights holder. All photos are shared by users.
